title: Cohen's kappa between two coders on a fixed sample
description: Chance-corrected agreement between two coders labelling the same cases: kappa = (p_o - p_e) / (1 - p_e). Four specifications from the residual audit are supported. Optional seeded bootstrap interval (percentile, 2.5% and 97.5%).
required_inputs: Group variable (country) for the calibration rule
assumptions: Both coders labelled the same cases independently.
Categories are nominal and mutually exclusive.
Original calculator row order is not recoverable, so bootstrap intervals differ slightly from published ones.
